text: This is K R's What If Explained. I went through nine studies for this one. First of January. You work at a desk. Your phone says you walk about five thousand steps a day. That's normal. A Stanford study of phone data from over a hundred countries found the world average is right about there. {playful} So you make a promise. Ten thousand. Every day. No excuses.
